rationale: Midpoint (hedge-loss 2500 bps = 25%) of a hedge-loss-magnitude sweep {1000, 2500, 4000} under a deposit-heavy 20-agent population (7 cautious-minter + 7 leverage-looper + 4 panic-redeemer + 2 arb-redeemer = 30% redemption-heavy). Classification flagged hedge_gap_depeg because the IDL declares an admin-gated apply_hedge_loss(loss_bps) with pool.cumulative_hedge_loss_bps + pool.effective_collateral_ratio_bps observable and panic-redeemer triggers on effective_collateral_ratio_bps < 10000. The deposit-heavy mix intentionally differs from the redemption-run-sweep's 50/50 population: hedge_gap_depeg pressure comes primarily from the scheduled haircut, not from organic redemption demand, so the scenario models a population the haircut has to push into panic. STAGING SCOPE: apply_hedge_loss is NOT runtime-dispatchable — the generic primitive's on_scheduled_action hook is a no-op, so this cell exercises only the pre-haircut persona mix; the true haircut + cascade axis is exercised by the named UXD-style collateral-cascade proof under fixtures/replays/stablecoin-uxd-style-collateral-cascade/ (anchored hash 2f61c0a7cfd592b0e625060ddc076cccb62093a1f0d5b5779fc8f548f7c2f2bf). collateral_ratio_spiral is cited as the downstream mode (secondary) per propose.md Rule 21.
